Other interests

Phone photography

A camera on your phone is one of my favourite inventions of the 20th century! I walk most mornings and am always looking for interesting things to photograph. I like seeing the abstract in the daily and familiar and how light plays on different surfaces. I live in a house on the end of a street so I get different light at all times of the day and through the year. Sometimes though, I just like taking pretty photos.

Writing

I love to write, I've written 1000s and 1000s of wrd over the years. I even wrote a rather odd sci-fi (speculative fiction) novel for NaNoWriMo a few years ago.

I've written screenplays (sometimes very loosely to allow the direction and action to have more of a free flow) for a few short films and the outlines for story-based music videos. I have a couple of unfilmed screenplays sitting around so if you'd be interested in a film collaboration, talk to me.
